docs.title: Open-source security libraries for PHP
docs.text: The documentation of each library: what it does, the specifications it implements, how to install it and where to ask about it.

docs.title: The frameworks
docs.text:
What an application installs for what it does: who the user is, what they may do, and the tokens and certificates that carry the answer.

Authentication WebAuthn Framework WebAuthn and passkeys for PHP and Symfony. web-auth/webauthn-lib Tokens JWT Framework JSON Web Tokens for PHP and Symfony: signature (JWS), encryption (JWE) and keys (JWK). web-token/jwt-framework One-time passwords OTPHP TOTP and HOTP one-time passwords, after RFC 6238 and RFC 4226. spomky-labs/otphp Authorization Access Control Framework Authorization for PHP and Symfony: decides whether a requester is allowed to perform an action on a subject. spomky-labs/access-control-lib Certificates PKI Framework X.509 certificates, ASN.1 and public key infrastructure. spomky-labs/pki-framework

docs.title: For Symfony applications
docs.text:
Bundles that hand an application a capability of the web platform, configured rather than written.

Progressive web apps PWA Bundle Progressive web apps for Symfony: manifest, service worker and offline support. spomky-labs/pwa-bundle Notifications Web Push Framework Web push notifications for PHP and Symfony. spomky-labs/web-push-lib

docs.title: The building blocks
docs.text:
The encoding and the cryptography the frameworks above stand on. Composer installs them for you; their documentation is here for the day you read a stack trace or write a layer of your own.

CBOR PHP CBOR encoding and decoding, after RFC 8949. spomky-labs/cbor-php COSE COSE signing, encryption and key management, after RFC 9052 and RFC 9053. web-auth/cose-lib
